options: петух
петуха
петуху
петухом
cases.translation: And just then the rooster crowed.
cases.explain: Петух is the subject of пропел (crowed), so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Первосвященники и учители закона искали удобного ___, чтобы хитростью схватить Иисуса и убить.
options: случай
случая
случаю
случаем
cases.translation: The chief priests and teachers of the law were looking for a good opportunity to seize Jesus by trickery and kill him.
cases.explain: The verb искать (to look for) governs the genitive → случая.

cases.sentence: Иуда Искариот, один из двенадцати, пошел к ___, чтобы предать им Иисуса.
options: первосвященники
первосвященников
первосвященникам
первосвященниками
cases.translation: Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
cases.explain: К (to) always takes the dative → первосвященникам.

cases.sentence: Первосвященники и учители закона искали удобного случая, чтобы хитростью схватить ___ и убить.
options: Иисус
Иисуса
Иисусу
Иисусом
cases.translation: The chief priests and teachers of the law were looking for a good opportunity to seize Jesus by trickery and kill him.
cases.explain: Иисуса is the direct object of схватить (to seize); animate masculine nouns take a genitive-like accusative ending.

cases.sentence: Он возлежал за ___, когда в дом вошла женщина с алебастровым кувшином очень дорогого ароматического масла.
options: стол
стола
столу
столом
cases.translation: He was reclining at the table when a woman came in with an alabaster jar of very costly perfumed oil.
cases.explain: За (at/behind) marking a fixed position takes the instrumental → столом.

cases.sentence: В ___ первосвященника, куда привели Иисуса, собрались все первосвященники, старейшины и учители закона.
options: дом
дома
дому
доме
cases.translation: In the house of the high priest, where Jesus was led, all the chief priests, elders and teachers of the law gathered.
cases.explain: В (in) marking a static location takes the prepositional → доме.

reading.ru: Первосвященники и учители закона искали удобного случая, чтобы хитростью схватить Иисуса и убить.
reading.question: What were the chief priests and teachers of the law looking for?
options: A sly way to arrest and kill Jesus
A way to crown Jesus king
A new temple site
A replacement for Judas
reading.correct: A sly way to arrest and kill Jesus
reading.explain: The chief priests and teachers of the law sought a cunning way to seize and kill Jesus.

reading.ru: Отбив запечатанное горлышко, она вылила масло на голову Иисусу.
reading.question: What did the woman at Bethany do with her jar of perfume?
options: She broke it open and poured the perfume on Jesus's head
She sold it and gave the money to the poor
She hid it under the table
She gave it to Judas as a gift
reading.correct: She broke it open and poured the perfume on Jesus's head
reading.explain: She broke open the sealed jar and poured the oil on Jesus's head.

reading.ru: Она сделала, что могла, заранее помазала мое тело для погребения.
reading.question: How did Jesus interpret the woman's action?
options: As anointing his body beforehand for burial
As an insult to his teaching
As a waste of valuable money
As a sign that she doubted him
reading.correct: As anointing his body beforehand for burial
reading.explain: Jesus said she had done what she could, anointing his body beforehand for burial.

reading.ru: Иуда Искариот, один из двенадцати, пошел к первосвященникам, чтобы предать им Иисуса.
reading.question: What did Judas Iscariot do after leaving the disciples?
options: He went to the chief priests to betray Jesus
He went to warn Jesus of danger
He fled to Galilee
He returned the money he had been given
reading.correct: He went to the chief priests to betray Jesus
reading.explain: Judas Iscariot went to the chief priests in order to betray Jesus to them.

reading.ru: Он покажет вам большую комнату наверху, приготовленную и убранную.
reading.question: What would the man show the two disciples sent into the city?
options: A large furnished room upstairs
A boat on the lake
An empty tomb
A field outside the city
reading.explain: The man would show them a large, furnished upper room to prepare for the Passover meal.

reading.ru: «Говорю вам истину, один из вас, кто сейчас ест со мной, предаст меня».
reading.question: What did Jesus announce during the meal with the twelve?
options: One of them eating with him would betray him
One of them would deny him three times
All of them would abandon their families
One of them would become the high priest
reading.correct: One of them eating with him would betray him
reading.explain: Jesus announced that one of those eating with him would betray him.

reading.question: What did Jesus say as he gave the disciples the bread?
options: "Take, this is my body"
"Eat, for tomorrow I die"
"Share this among yourselves"
"Remember Moses when you eat"
reading.explain: As he broke the bread and gave it to them, Jesus said, "Take, this is my body."

reading.ru: «Это моя кровь завета, проливаемая за многих», — сказал Иисус.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about the cup he shared with the disciples?
options: It was his blood of the covenant, poured out for many
It was ordinary wine for the feast
It represented the wine of Cana
It was a gift from Simon the leper
reading.correct: It was his blood of the covenant, poured out for many
reading.explain: Jesus called the cup his blood of the covenant, poured out for many.

reading.ru: «В эту ночь, прежде чем петух пропоет два раза, ты трижды отречешься от меня».
reading.question: What did Jesus predict Peter would do that very night?
options: Deny him three times before the rooster crowed twice
Betray him to the chief priests
Fall asleep during the arrest
Draw his sword against the soldiers
reading.correct: Deny him three times before the rooster crowed twice
reading.explain: Jesus told Peter that before the rooster crowed twice that night, Peter would deny him three times.

reading.ru: Отойдя немного, он пал на землю и молился, чтобы, если возможно, этот час миновал его.
reading.question: What did Jesus pray for in Gethsemane?
options: That the hour might pass from him, if possible
That his disciples would stay awake
That Judas would repent
That the temple would be spared
reading.correct: That the hour might pass from him, if possible
reading.explain: Jesus fell to the ground and prayed that, if possible, the hour might pass from him.

reading.ru: «Бодрствуйте и молитесь, чтобы вам не поддаться искушению. Дух бодр, но тело слабо».
reading.question: What did Jesus tell Peter, James and John after finding them asleep?
options: To watch and pray so as not to fall into temptation
To leave the garden immediately
To find Judas before he arrived
To prepare swords for the coming arrest
reading.correct: To watch and pray so as not to fall into temptation
reading.explain: Jesus told them to watch and pray so they would not fall into temptation, since the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.

reading.ru: Придя на место, Иуда сразу же подошел к Иисусу и сказал «Рабби» и поцеловал его.
reading.question: How did Judas identify Jesus to the arresting crowd?
options: By greeting him as "Rabbi" and kissing him
By pointing at him from a distance
By calling out his name loudly
By handing him a written note
reading.correct: By greeting him as "Rabbi" and kissing him
reading.explain: Judas approached Jesus, said "Rabbi," and kissed him as the prearranged signal.

reading.ru: Один из стоявших рядом вытащил меч, ударил им слугу первосвященника и отсек ему ухо.
reading.question: What did one of the bystanders do when Jesus was seized?
options: He drew a sword and cut off the ear of the high priest's servant
He ran to warn the disciples
He begged the soldiers for mercy
He threw stones at the crowd
reading.correct: He drew a sword and cut off the ear of the high priest's servant
reading.explain: One of those standing nearby drew his sword and cut off the high priest's servant's ear.

reading.ru: Когда его схватили, он вырвался и убежал голый, оставив покрывало в руках у стражников.
reading.question: What happened to the young man who was following Jesus when the guards seized him?
options: He slipped away naked, leaving his linen cloth behind
He was arrested along with Jesus
He fought off the guards with a sword
He hid inside the high priest's house
reading.correct: He slipped away naked, leaving his linen cloth behind
reading.explain: When they seized him, the young man escaped naked, leaving his linen cloth in the guards' hands.

reading.ru: «Ты ли Христос, Сын Благословенного?» «Я», — ответил Иисус.
reading.question: How did Jesus respond when the high priest asked if he was the Christ?
options: He affirmed it, saying "I am"
He remained completely silent
He denied it outright
He asked for more time to answer
reading.explain: When asked if he was the Christ, the Son of the Blessed, Jesus answered, "I am."

reading.question: How did Peter react after the rooster crowed the second time and he remembered Jesus's words?
options: He wept bitterly
He ran to tell the other disciples
He confronted the servant girl
He immediately confessed to the high priest
reading.explain: Remembering Jesus's prediction after the second crow of the rooster, Peter broke down and wept bitterly.
